rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:1.2: can: The header on p505-strip0.jpg prints LOWRY 8.7.8.7.D. Stanza 1's row sings line 2 as 7 syllables at the end of system 1 (p505-strip0.jpg) and line 3 as 8 at the start of system 2 (p505-strip800.jpg); the moved word makes them 8 and 7, which breaks the metre. The moved word's capital follows a question mark, so the capital alone would not show it.
